description: This file defines the AmqpEndpoint interface which provides methods for managing AMQP links and connections within the Eclipse Hono project. It declares methods for handling link attachments (both send and receive) and connection closures, serving as a contract for classes implementing AMQP endpoint behavior.

classes.name: AmqpEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining AMQP endpoint operations for establishing links and handling connection states within the Hono framework.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles a client's request to establish an AMQP link for sending messages, given the connection, receiver, and target address.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles a client's request to establish an AMQP link for receiving messages, given the connection, sender, and source address.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when an AMQP connection is closed, either actively or due to a broken/lost connection.
